He has white cotton gloves on both hands and a black crossbody bag strapped across his torso. His face is contorted into a humorous grimace as he begins a rhythmic dancing motion, jerking his torso to the side as if dodging a poke. The background features lush, green mountainous terrain under an overcast, greyish sky. (2) The character continues his rhythmic performance, moving his arms and body in sharp, punctuated gestures. He frequently touches his sides and legs as he dances through the rows of spiky pineapple plants, his facial expressions alternating rapidly between feigned pain and wide-eyed excitement. The pineapple plants are dense and low to the ground, filling the foreground with sharp, pointed leaves and small developing fruits. (3) Moving deeper into the field, the man executes a series of coordinated hand movements, pointing and gesturing towards the camera while maintaining the dance beat. He smiles and laughs at the camera, showing high energy. In the distant background, a small white building and several tall, thin trees are visible against the backdrop of the steep, forested hills.
